subject: Billing system transition — temporary manual invoices & VAT mapping
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Billing system transition — temporary manual invoices & VAT mapping

Hi Marta,

Quick heads-up: we're scheduled to cut over Acme's billing to our new portal on Monday, 2026-09-06. During the two-week enrollment window there will be a short period where the portal will accept enrollments but not yet push invoices to external AP systems. To avoid any disruption to your payment process we can send manual PDF invoices by email or a one-off SFTP push until your portal enrollment is fully live.

Can you confirm your AP team's preference (email PDF to ap@acme-corp.com vs SFTP drop)? If email, are there any strict subject/attachment naming requirements or mandatory invoice fields (e.g., originator, bill-to, PO#) your system needs?

Separately, you mentioned VAT-exempt customers in our previous call. If Acme has customers or entities claiming VAT exemption, please attach the exemption document for our records (we'll tag invoices accordingly). I've attached a small sample invoice (sample_invoice_canary.pdf) showing the metadata we put in the subject and the invoice footer so you can confirm mapping.

Proposed temporary plan (if you agree):
- 2026-09-06 through 2026-09-20: Redwood sends manual PDF invoices to ap@acme-corp.com (cc to your accounting alias if needed).
- We'll include PO# in both the invoice PDF and the email subject ("INV-<number> | PO=<po#>").
- If VAT exemption applies, include the exemption ID as a separate attachment and we will set invoice VAT=0 for that entity.

If email is OK, we'll send a single canary invoice tomorrow demonstrating the expected filename and subject. If you prefer SFTP, we need host/user/key details and an example filename pattern.

Thanks — aiming to avoid any payment delays during cutover.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_invoice_canary.pdf (PDF, stub)

From: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@acme-corp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme AP <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Billing system transition — temporary manual invoices & VAT mapping

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the advance notice. Email PDFs to ap@acme-corp.com will work for us during the window. A couple of specifics from AP:

- Subject line must contain the PO# and the invoice number (we prefer "Invoice <inv#> | PO <po#>").
- File attachment should be the PDF only, named "ACME_INV_<inv#>.pdf".
- If VAT exemption applies, attach the exemption certificate (PDF) and reference the exemption ID on the invoice. AP will not process without that certificate.

I've attached Acme's VAT exemption form for entity ACME-NE (acme_vat_exemption_form.pdf). Our AP team also requested that the invoice PDF include an "Originator" field in the header that shows who on your side generated the invoice — we use that for routing.

We'll be monitoring for the canary invoice and will confirm once it's processed.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Billing system transition — temporary manual invoices & VAT mapping

Thanks for looping us in, Dylan. Good to hear Acme prefers email PDFs — that will be the faster path. A couple of operational notes and required mappings before we send the canary:

1) Email subject and attachment naming
- Subject: "Invoice <INV#> | PO <PO#> | ACME-<entity>"
- Attachment filename: "ACME_INV_<INV#>.pdf"

2) Mandatory invoice fields in the PDF (place in header metadata so AP's OCR picks them up):
- Originator: full name + email (we will populate with the Redwood agent who generated the invoice)
- Bill-to: customer legal entity (e.g., "Acme Health Systems - NE")
- PO#: exact match to what Acme sends on the PO
- VAT tag: one of ["standard","reverse_charge","exempt"] — map exempt when we have a certificate attached

3) Delivery cadence & fallback
- We'll send a canary invoice to ap@acme-corp.com and cc your accounting alias tomorrow morning.
- If the canary is accepted, we'll proceed with nightly sends for any invoices generated that day.
- If AP reports parsing issues, Connor will coordinate a temporary SFTP drop for the rest of the cutover window.

Connor: please prepare the invoice generation pipeline to insert Originator metadata (we can use "Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>") and to attach any provided exemption PDFs. Also add a note in the body of the email with a short list of invoice line items for quick AP reconciliation.

I'll be on standby to handle any quick fixes.

—Kimberly
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
